payload.title: The Jellybean Quiz: ten questions for testing what a listener remembers of any story
payload.body: The quiz is ten questions asked one minute after a story ends: five about the plot, three about the characters, and two about the setting. Each correct answer earns one jellybean, for a score from 0 to 10. It works for any story and any audience; ask every listener the same questions in the same order. These demonstration methods describe no real experiment.
